title: pkix-aia-http: shipped docs reference PKIX-zkjb.5.1, a bead that was never filed
description:
## What

Three places in pkix-aia-http point readers at tracking bead PKIX-zkjb.5.1:

- pkix-aia-http/src/lib.rs:117-119 — 'is filed as PKIX-zkjb.5.1, deferred until consumer demand surfaces'
- pkix-aia-http/Cargo.toml:21 — 'Async variant is filed as PKIX-zkjb.5.1 when demand surfaces.'

`bd show PKIX-zkjb.5.1` returns nothing. PKIX-zkjb itself is CLOSED with close reason 'all steps complete', so the parent is done and the child was never created. The async AIA variant was not deferred — it was dropped on the floor, with shipped crate documentation asserting it is tracked.

pkix-aia-http is published, so this dangling reference is live on docs.rs: a reader who wants the async story is directed to an identifier that does not resolve.

## Why it is its own bead

The actual async work is PKIX-j72x. This doc defect should be fixable independently of whether j72x ever lands, since the wrong claim is shipped today either way.

## Fix

Either point the text at PKIX-j72x, or drop the bead reference and state the limitation plainly. Also re-check the 'deferred until consumer demand surfaces' wording against AGENTS.md's 'Project phase and decision framing', which rejects that frame by name (see PKIX-j72x for detail).

## Also worth a sweep

Memory keys referenced in closed beads do not resolve either: PKIX-a1yc.10's close reason cites 'bd memory pkix-a1yc-10-architectural-decision-option-c-asyncrevocation' and PKIX-j32w cites 'Memory pkix-dane-architecture-2026-05-12', but `bd memories` reports 'No memories stored.' Design rationale that beads claim is captured in memory is not actually retrievable. That is a larger problem than this doc reference and may deserve its own bead.

## Acceptance

[ ] No source or manifest comment in pkix-aia-http references a nonexistent bead
[ ] Grep the workspace for other bead references that do not resolve
